verses.pali: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, telañca paṭicca vaṭṭiñca paṭicca telappadīpo jhāyeyya.
verses.english: “Mendicants, suppose an oil lamp depended on oil and a wick to burn.

verses.pali: Tatra puriso kālena kālaṁ telaṁ āsiñceyya vaṭṭiṁ upasaṁhareyya.
verses.english: And from time to time someone would pour oil in and adjust the wick.

verses.pali: Evañhi so, bhikkhave, telappadīpo tadāhāro tadupādāno ciraṁ dīghamaddhānaṁ jaleyya.
verses.english: Fed and fuelled by that, the oil lamp would burn for a long time.

verses.pali: Evameva kho, bhikkhave, saṁyojaniyesu dhammesu assādānupassino viharato taṇhā pavaḍḍhati.
verses.english: In the same way, there are things that tighten the fetters. When you concentrate on the gratification provided by these things, your craving grows.
Craving is a requirement for grasping. …
That is how this entire mass of suffering originates.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, telañca paṭicca vaṭṭiñca paṭicca telappadīpo jhāyeyya.
verses.english: Suppose an oil lamp depended on oil and a wick to burn.

verses.pali: Tatra puriso na kālena kālaṁ telaṁ āsiñceyya na vaṭṭiṁ upasaṁhareyya.
verses.english: And no-one would pour oil in and adjust the wick from time to time.

verses.pali: Evañhi so, bhikkhave, telappadīpo purimassa ca upādānassa pariyādānā aññassa ca anupahārā anāhāro nibbāyeyya.
verses.english: As the original fuel is used up and no more is added, the oil lamp would be extinguished due to not being fed.

verses.pali: Evameva kho, bhikkhave, saṁyojaniyesu dhammesu ādīnavānupassino viharato taṇhā nirujjhati.
verses.english: In the same way, there are things that tighten the fetters. When you concentrate on the drawbacks of these things, your craving ceases.
That is how this entire mass of suffering ceases.”
